title: Packet loss: TCP retransmissions
summary: 5 TCP segments were sent again on 1 connection(s); the worst sender retransmitted 6.25% of its data. Retransmission means a segment (or its ACK) was lost or badly delayed, which costs throughput and adds delay. 17 duplicate ACKs and 0 fast retransmissions confirm the receiver noticed gaps. Most retransmissions were sent *towards* the capture side, so packets were lost before they reached the capture point.
